name: Distracted Boyfriend
look: A stock photo on a city street. A man in a blue plaid shirt, walking with his girlfriend, turns to stare back at a passing woman in a red dress on the left. His girlfriend, in a light blue top on the right, glares at him in disbelief.
use: Each of the three people gets a label. The man is whoever is tempted, the woman in red is the shiny new distraction, and the girlfriend is the responsibility or old favorite being ignored.
slots: the tempting new thing (woman in red, left)
examples: The four hobbies I bought gear for last month
describe: guy turning around to check out a girl in a red dress
man looks back at another woman while his girlfriend is mad
girlfriend glaring at her boyfriend who is staring at someone else
couple on a street and the dude is eyeing a passing woman
jealous girlfriend in blue top and boyfriend in plaid shirt
origin: A 2015 stock photo; it took off as a meme in 2017.
